landing.heroTitle: Find a trusted cleaner near you.
landing.heroSubtitle: Compare verified cleaners by service, hourly rate and availability, then agree the details in a private chat.
landing.trustBadge: Every badge checked by our team
landing.verifyTitle: Know who is coming into your home
landing.verifyLead: Every verified badge is earned through a selfie check reviewed by a real person on our team, so you can tell genuine profiles apart at a glance.
landing.verifyStep1Body: We ask for a selfie copying a pose we pick at random, so an old or borrowed photo won't pass.
landing.verifyStep2Body: A member of our team compares the selfie with the profile photo. No automated guesswork.
landing.verifyStep3Body: Approved profiles show a verified badge, so you know who's real before you invite them in.
landing.verifyPrivacy: Your selfie stays private: it's never shown to other members and is deleted once the review is done.
landing.peopleLookingHint: See services, rates and availability before you write. Sign up to start a conversation.
landing.europeBody: Linpura connects households and independent cleaners in 8 countries, with more cities joining soon.
landing.priceTitle: Subscribe now and get 3 months free
landing.ctaTitle: Your cleaner is a few clicks away
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join Linpura and find help for your home this week.
landing.step1Body: Filter by service, hourly rate, the days you need and the area you live in.
landing.step2Body: Message cleaners privately to agree on tasks, timing and price before anyone comes over.
landing.step3Title: Come home to a clean space
landing.step3Body: Whether it's a weekly clean, a move-out or a one-off deep clean, get the help that suits you.
landing.reason1Body: Hourly rates are on every cleaner's profile, so there are no surprises.
landing.reason2Body: Selfie checks reviewed by our team help you know who you are inviting in.
landing.reason3Body: See which days and times each cleaner works and the areas they cover.
landing.reason4Body: Cleaners set their own rates, choose their areas and decide which jobs to take.
landing.postsTitle: Say what you need, or what you offer
landing.postsBody: Cleaners post short announcements. Clients post job requests. Both appear on the profile, and anyone can search them.
landing.announcementsBody: Cleaners share free slots, special services or offers. The latest one also appears on their card.
landing.requestsBody: Clients describe the jobs they need done. Cleaners search them and write when they can help.
landing.postsSearch: Search uses the same words. Type a service or a keyword and the list filters to it.
